title: The Mystic Energy Equilibrium
statement:
An array of N energy crystals with positive or negative charges is arranged linearly. An archaeologist needs to find contiguous subarrays of crystals whose combined energy equals K.

Given an integer array and a target integer K, return the total number of continuous subarrays whose sum equals K.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and K.
Second line: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print the count of continuous subarrays whose sum equals K.

sampleCases.explanation: Subarrays [1, 1] at indices [0..1] and [1..2] each sum to 2.
